title: Охота на Вику и браслет Саши  (Pursuing Vika and Sasha's Bracelet)

segments.t: Peering through the office window into the dining room, Aleksandr asks Max whether art director Vika is seeing anyone and immediately sets his sights on her. Moments later, Vika steps in to tell the new chef that guests are waiting to greet him, while Sasha shows off her bracelet at the bar.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?
'Listen, who is Louis over there with?' Notice how Russian expresses 'listen' and 'whom' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Senya answers right away.
'Come on, I am just kidding.' In Russian, the idea of 'yes' flows naturally into 'am joking' without extra filler words.
'And what about our director?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'our'.
'She does not seem to be with anyone.' The grammar packs 'that' and 'whom' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Senya answers right away.
'You do not say.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'come on'.
'Actually, the guests were asking for you.' Louis brings out the contrast between 'come on' and 'actually' in a few short words.
'Tell them for me.' The meaning hinges on 'say' working together with 'it' in spoken Russian. Senya answers right away.
'No, no, not right now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'no' and 'any minute' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'It is my first day at the restaurant.' Louis anchors the line on 'first', while 'restaurant' completes the thought.
'Well, how could anyone say no to me?' Notice how Russian expresses 'come on' and 'to refuse' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Senya answers right away.
'This is already the third bracelet.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'bracelet'.
'Do you see this right here?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'see' before landing on 'this'.

'All right, I am going to get back to work.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'really?!' and finishing on 'to work for a while'. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Слушай, а вот это, Луи, с кем?
